title: 第1550章 给你一百回合第1549章 劫后余生
content_zh:
狡谋鬼蛇冲破封印，在阴阳古界大肆屠戮天神，无人可阻，它吸收了积攒数亿年的，来自上界全部天神们不间断的恶意（源自天神的负面感情与自身作为神的幽暗面），这种恶意力量的加持，令它的实力达到了恐怖至极的准界主级别。
青天世界的界外虚空与法则之罚的事情刚结束不久，万界庭与八大宗损失惨重，原本他们两大势力，是需要修身养息恢复一段时间，但阴阳古界出事，他们也需要派人前往支援。
两大势力，在挽救青天世界后，人才凋零，万界庭以丰厚家底吸引其他天神来破帮助青天世界渡过危难，被天神们兑换走的资源最多，经此大事件后活下来的天神，都有拯救青天世界危亡的英雄称号，且万界庭格外奖励一笔贡献分，而因此大事件而死的天神，贡献分翻倍，且仍然可以由其亲属，家人朋友进行兑换，所以万界庭积累数亿年的资源，在万人兑换瓜分下，至下少去十分之一，这十分之一，可是无数代天神神官们一亿年的积累！
万界庭内至宝重宝和稀世仙材与上古或近代极强的功法或禁法残章等被天神们兑换走有五成以上，基础平常资源却是不到三成，看来所有的天神都不傻，基础的资源永远比不上这些千百年见都可能见不到的珍贵资源。
万界庭人手少去一半，原本万人以上的神官体系，令整个青天世界庞大的系统维持运转，现在人手缺失，万界庭所管理的全部区域（包括青天世界之外的其它十方世界的公共资源点），出现无人管理的情况。
万界庭资源损失严重，人手欠失严重，其内部高层，决定让其它两大势力先行对阴阳古界进行援助，而万界庭休整几日便会赶到，当然支援的力度一定不如其它两大势力。
万界庭神主为拯救青天世界而献出生命，万界庭高层向十方世界发送讣告与传奇事迹，决定在一个月后，为神主举办天下大葬，入住至高天（无数英烈天神之墓）。
八大宗身为万界庭之下第一附属大势力，拼尽人手与家底，好在他们阻止了青天世界的灭亡，对于阴阳古界凶蛇出世，他们八大宗当中有许多人的出生与老家都来自那里，所以那些来自那里的天神们冒着生命危险早就回去了，刚经历完青天世界将要覆灭的大事件，极大部分天神，先前即使胆小害怕死亡，现在有也无所畏惧的勇气，这勇气来自他们死去的伙伴朋友与同事，他们经历了生与死的淬炼，自然拥有了血性。
八位长老，了解阴阳古界情况，就有了出手的打算，这绝对不是一只简单的体型巨大的凶蛇，而是至少是传奇异能兽且懂得异能修炼等全部其它的手段，一个行走的智慧的强大至极的野兽，它的来源，早在六亿多年前就已经出现，被一位神秘无名大侠击败并封印，喜欢行侠仗义的九长老流水真君第一时间便赶往那里。
狡谋鬼蛇被阴阳古界的天神们称为极恶魔蛇，它的杀死天神的顺序，优先挑选老弱病残，而后才是正常的天神，它杀死天神，往往还伴随着极度残忍的折磨，与令天神自相残杀的令人发指的变态行径，阴阳古界的天神民众，闻之名，无人不彻骨胆寒，它的邪恶，在民间有口口相传的故事传说，以及许多关于它的志怪书籍，无一例外，对它的描述都是极为凶残的，年长老人往往会以这些吓唬那些不听话的孩子。
狡谋鬼蛇，破坏阴阳古界的城镇建筑，从偏远之地一路杀向并摧毁核心地段，永昼地区率先遭殃，无数天神平民，陷入到地狱之中。
“杀得还不够尽兴，还不足以平息吾心中的快感与仇恨，哼，如今的天神，真是弱小的可怜，一下子杀死他们一大片，没有什么复仇的快感，不如……”狡谋鬼蛇庞大的身躯，延伸数万米，它张口大嘴，从口中凝聚出一个人形，人形的外貌是一个高达四五米的壮年男子，这名男子来到永昼赌市，而当今永昼之主堂献花携一众下属，出门迎敌。
八级超级法器——赌楼，乃是永昼中心的主楼，它拔地而起，四面八方环壁，雕刻着上界五任伟大界主的壁画，恢宏玉宇的主楼之下，延伸出数十座漂浮的小楼。
这座超级法器赌楼，由第一任赌楼之主与长夜帝君草创，经后历代无数任赌市之主完善，身具运道与死道的双重加持，以及壁画上的伟大界主的神力庇佑。
“这副身躯真是丑陋啊，不过若是吾本尊出动，你们会瞬间死亡，这太没有意思了。吾乃狡谋鬼蛇，而非你们口中那个奇葩的名字极恶魔蛇，谁是这里的统领者，限你三秒钟自报家门，否则吾即刻覆灭永昼！”狡谋鬼蛇沉闷具有强穿透的洪音，震慑全场，它先要杀灭阴阳古界当中还活着的数百万天神，而后再去往其它大界继续杀戮，天神，一个都不能放过。
“我是这里的统领者，堂献花！”堂献花自报家门，这永昼是他祖上祖祖辈辈积累至今的产业，他决不能让狡谋鬼蛇给毁了，他知道狡谋鬼蛇无与伦比的强大，此次与之对战，多半是凶多吉少，其实永昼赌市即使消失，三大势力一定会重新增设新赌市，赌市以赌与娱乐闻名，其牵扯天神们无数外债与流动资产，若是赌市彻底消失，那些欠债的天神岂不是不用还钱了？三大势力当然不允许，还有上界的赌市，并非单一的以赌为主要目地的地方，它还牵扯了太多赚大钱的产业，远比单一经营某一类资源点暴利强百倍，所以三大势力永远不会令它停止运营，只是当今堂家如果败亡，新的由三大势力所派的人员，一定会将其接替。
堂家经营赌市自今六亿多年之久，受到三大势力时刻监督，所以阴阳古界的监督神官最多，堂家虽然从未犯过什么错误，可一直令一个家族掌权，就怕它有一天不听话，三大势力共同讨论，一直想让自己的人去接替，但又碍于三大势力的人员，各有各的私心，所以就让堂家一直安于现状。
堂献花可以不用赌上性命，他可以向外逃亡，然而他还是选择留下来，阻挡叫狡谋鬼蛇继续前进，为更多平民百姓争取逃跑的活路，这一刻，无数天神平民感谢他，虽然以前他们是厌恶这个永昼之主的，因为他的赌市令多少幸福美满的家庭破灭。
“很好，堂献花，你这只小蝼蚁，没有超过吾读数的三秒，现在，用尽你的全力在吾分身下撑够一百回合，我允许你们之中一半的天神活下来”狡谋鬼蛇庞大的身躯凌空像阴云一样笼罩着永昼，而其暴虐的分身，力大势沉双拳缠绕着恐怖的恶蛇之气朝堂献花冲击而去。
content_en:
The cunning ghost snake breaks through the seal and slaughters the gods in the Yin and Yang ancient world. No one can stop it. It has absorbed the uninterrupted malice of all the gods from the upper world accumulated for hundreds of millions of years (derived from the negative emotions of the gods and the dark side of itself as a god). The blessing of this malicious power has made its strength reach the extremely terrifying quasi-realm master level.
Not long after the incident of the outer void and the punishment of laws in the Blue Sky World, the Ten Thousand Realms Court and the Eight Great Sects suffered heavy losses. Originally, their two major forces needed to recuperate and recover for a period of time, but something happened in the Yin and Yang Ancient World, and they also needed to send people to support them.
After the two major forces saved the Qingtian World, their talents withered. Wan Jie Ting used its rich wealth to attract other gods to help the Qing Tian World through the crisis. The resources exchanged by the gods were the largest. The gods who survived this major incident were all titled as heroes for saving the Qing Tian World from danger, and Wan Jie Ting gave a special reward of one. Each contribution point is doubled, and the contribution points of the gods who died due to the major event are doubled, and can still be exchanged by their relatives, family and friends. Therefore, the resources accumulated by Wanjie Ting for hundreds of millions of years, if exchanged and divided by thousands of people, will be reduced to at least one-tenth. This one-tenth is the accumulation of countless generations of gods and priests over 100 million years!
More than 50% of the treasures and rare immortal materials in the Court of All Realms, as well as ancient or modern extremely powerful skills or forbidden spell fragments, have been exchanged by the gods for exchange, but the basic ordinary resources are less than 30%. It seems that all the gods are not stupid, and the basic resources can never be compared to these precious resources that may not be seen for thousands of years.
The manpower of Wanjieting has been reduced by half. The priest system of more than 10,000 people originally kept the huge system of Qingtian World running. Now there is a lack of manpower. All areas managed by Wanjieting (including public resource points in other Shifang Worlds outside Qingtian World) are unmanaged.
The Ten Thousand Realms Ting suffered a serious loss of resources and a serious shortage of manpower. Its internal high-level officials decided to let the other two major forces provide assistance to the Yin-Yang Ancient Realm first. The Ten Thousand Realms Ting would arrive after a few days of rest. Of course, the intensity of the support would not be as strong as the other two major forces.
The Divine Lord of Wanjieting sacrificed his life to save the world of Qingtian. The senior officials of Wanjieting sent obituaries and legendary deeds to the worlds of all directions. They decided to hold a world-wide funeral for the Divine Lord one month later and move into the High Heaven (the tomb of countless heroes and gods).
The eight major sects, as the largest affiliated force under the Court of Ten Thousand Realms, spent all their manpower and wealth. Fortunately, they prevented the destruction of the Qingtian World. Regarding the birth of the evil snake in the Yin-Yang Ancient Realm, many of the eight major sects were born and came from there, so the gods who came from there risked their lives. Xian has gone back a long time ago. They have just experienced the major event that the world of Qingtian will be destroyed. Most of the gods, even if they were timid and afraid of death before, now have the courage to be fearless. This courage comes from their dead partners, friends and colleagues. They have experienced the tempering of life and death, and naturally have the blood nature.
The eight elders, after understanding the situation in the Yin-Yang Ancient World, made plans to take action. This was definitely not a simple huge vicious snake, but at least a legendary supernatural beast that knew all other methods such as supernatural power cultivation. It was a walking, intelligent and extremely powerful beast. Its origin had appeared more than 600 million years ago. It was defeated and sealed by a mysterious unknown hero. The Ninth Elder Liushui Zhenjun, who likes to be chivalrous and righteous, rushed there immediately.
The cunning ghost snake is called the extremely devil snake by the gods of the Yin and Yang ancient world. Its order of killing the gods gives priority to the old, weak, sick and disabled, and then the normal gods. When it kills the gods, it is often accompanied by extremely cruel torture, and orders that make the gods kill each other. The deities and people of the ancient world of Yin and Yang are all frightened to their bones when they hear the name of this perverted behavior. Its evil has stories and legends passed down orally among the people, as well as many books about it. Without exception, the descriptions of it are extremely cruel., older people often use these to scare disobedient children.
The cunning ghost snake destroyed the town buildings in the ancient world of Yin and Yang, killing and destroying the core areas from remote places. The Yongzhou area was the first to suffer, and countless gods and civilians fell into hell.
"Killing is not enough to satisfy the pleasure and hatred in my heart. Huh, today's gods are really weak and pitiful. Killing a large number of them at once does not give me the pleasure of revenge. How about..." The huge body of the cunning ghost snake Its body extends tens of thousands of meters. It opens its mouth and condenses a humanoid figure from its mouth. The humanoid appearance is a strong man four or five meters tall. This man came to Yongzhou Casino, and today the main hall of Yongzhou Xianhua and a group of subordinates went out to meet the enemy.
The eighth-level super magic weapon, Gambling Building, is the main building of Yongzhi Center. It rises from the ground and is surrounded by walls on all sides, engraved with murals of the five great world masters of the upper world. Dozens of small floating buildings extend under the majestic main building of Yuyu.
This super magic weapon gambling house was founded by the first gambling house owner and the Evernight Emperor, and was perfected by countless gambling owners in the subsequent generations. It has the dual blessings of luck and death, as well as the divine blessing of the great world master on the mural.
"This body is really ugly, but if I were to take action, you would die instantly. This is too boring. I am the cunning ghost snake, not the weird name of the devil snake in your mouth. Who is the leader here? You have only three seconds to declare your home. Door, otherwise I will destroy Yongzhi immediately!" The cunning ghost snake's dull and penetrating sound shocked the entire audience. It will first kill the millions of gods still alive in the ancient world of Yin and Yang, and then go to other great realms to continue killing. No god can be spared.
"I am the leader here, Tang Xianhua!" Tang Xianhua reported to his family. This eternal day is the inheritance accumulated by his ancestors for generations. He must not let the cunning ghost snake destroy it. He knows that the cunning ghost snake is unparalleledly powerful. This time, the battle with it will probably be fierce. What's more, in fact, even if the Everlasting Gambling Market disappears, the three major forces will definitely add a new gambling market. The gambling market is famous for gambling and entertainment, and it involves countless foreign debts and liquid assets of the gods. If the gambling market completely disappears, won't the gods who owe money not have to pay back the money? Of course, the three major forces will not allow it. There is also the gambling market in the upper realm. It is not just a place where gambling is the main purpose. It also involves too many industries that make big money, which is a hundred times more powerful than just operating a certain type of resource point to make huge profits. Therefore, the three major forces will never stop it from operating. However, if the current family fails, new personnel sent by the three major forces will definitely take over.
The Tang family has been operating the gambling market for more than 600 million years and has been constantly supervised by the three major forces. Therefore, the ancient Yin and Yang world has the most supervisory priests. Although the Tang family has never made any mistakes, it has always kept a family in power, fearing that it would disobey one day. The three major forces discussed together and always wanted their own people to take over. However, due to the fact that the personnel of the three major forces each have their own selfish motives, the Tang family has always been content with the status quo.
Tang Xianhua did not need to risk his life, he could flee, but he still chose to stay, blocking the cunning ghost snake from moving forward, and providing more civilians with a way to escape. At this moment, countless gods and civilians thanked him, although they used to hate the Lord of Eternal Day because his gambling ruined many happy families.
"Very good, Tang Xianhua, you little ant has not exceeded the three seconds of my reading. Now, use all your strength to hold on for a hundred rounds under my clone. I will allow half of you gods to survive." The cunning ghost snake's huge body soared into the sky and enveloped Yongji like a dark cloud, while its violent clone, powerful and powerful, wrapped its fists around the terrifying evil snake energy and rushed towards Tang Xianhua.
